title: Agent CLI permission-prompt bypass vulnerabilities fixed in Claude Code (Aug 2026)
summary: August 2026 Claude Code releases fixed a Bash permission bypass where crafted commands could hide parts of themselves from permission checks, invisible-Unicode/tab padding hiding command parts in approval dialogs, workflow-sandbox escape via dynamic import(), and an agent-definition bypassPermissions gap ignoring org policy. Confirms the agent surface itself remains an active intrusion vector.

evidence.summary: Provider fixed multiple permission-prompt bypass and sandbox-escape vulnerabilities in August 2026 releases.
